title: English Practice Quiz 0761
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: The bus is ___ than the car today.
questions.explanation: Use the comparative form faster when comparing two things.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.

questions.question: If a task is 'urgent', it needs ___.
questions.explanation: Urgent means requiring immediate or prompt attention.
